column1: # The comparable populations found in this set of papers.

column2: Simple-span C and Z purlins with through-fastened panels under uplift
column3: Simple-span (single-span) assemblies of two C or Z purlin lines with a through-fastened (screwed) roof panel on the tension flange, loaded to failure by chamber suction; all rows share the same member type, panel attachment and span condition, so their strengths are directly comparable. Includes the MBMA_1103 wall girt tests (same test arrangement).
column6: MBMA_1103; MBMA_9501; MBMA_8702; MBMA_8310; MBMA_8404; MBMA_8001; MBMA_9003

column2: Standing seam roof systems on C and Z purlins under uplift
column3: Vacuum-chamber uplift tests of standing seam roof systems on C or Z purlins, comprising single-span base tests and the matching three-span confirming tests of the Base Test Method; the clip-and-seam restraint makes these a different population from through-fastened assemblies.

column2: Continuous multi-span C and Z purlins with through-fastened panels under uplift
column3: Multi-span (mostly three-span) continuous lapped C and Z purlin assemblies with through-fastened panels tested to failure under chamber uplift; continuity over interior supports and the lapped splice make these a distinct population from simple-span tests.

column2: Through-fastened panel fastener pullover tests in a vacuum box
column3: Vacuum-box tests of through-fastened panel assemblies instrumented with load cells at every screw, loaded until fastener pullover or pullout; the measured quantity is a fastener load and a chamber pressure, not a purlin bending strength.
